Module.name: luminiris
Module.Description:
LuminIRIS - A modern glassmorphism-style management console for InterSystems IRIS 2026.2+. The front-end (HTML/CSS/JS) talks directly to the official SysAdmin REST API (/api/admin, mainspec_v2 OpenAPI specification).
It additionally ships one small ObjectScript class, Luminiris.PythonApi (extends %CSP.REST), which exposes the built-in Embedded Python engine at /luminiris/api/python so the portal can run Python inside the IRIS process.
After installation in the USER namespace the portal is served at: http://<host>:52773/csp/user/luminiris/index.html
